title: Discriminative vs Generative AI
description: Compare predicting labels P(y|x) with modeling data distributions P(x). Overview VAEs, GANs, Diffusion, and Autoregressive LLMs.

slides.title: Separating vs Creating 🎨
slides.content:
# The Paradigm Shift: From Classification to Creation

Historically, machine learning focused on **Discriminative Models**: drawing decision boundaries to separate classes (e.g. "Is this photo a cat or dog?").

**Generative AI** models the underlying probability distribution of the data $P(\mathbf{X})$, enabling systems to sample *brand-new, realistic artifacts* (e.g. "Generate a photo of an astronaut riding a horse on Mars").

slides.title: Comparing Generative Families 🏛️
slides.content:
# The Generative Architecture Zoo

| Generative Family | Core Mechanism | Strengths | Typical Domains |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Autoregressive Transformers** | Predicts next token conditioned on past: $P(x_t \mid x_{<t})$ | Coherent long-form text, code, reasoning | ChatGPT, Claude, LLaMA |
| **Diffusion Models** | Iteratively denoises Gaussian noise into structured data | Exceptional image fidelity and diversity | Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Sora |
| **GANs (Generative Adversarial)** | Generator & Discriminator engage in zero-sum minimax game | Fast single-step inference | Real-time face generation (StyleGAN) |
| **VAEs (Variational Autoencoders)** | Encodes data into smooth probabilistic latent space | Structured mathematical latent interpolation | Molecule discovery, anomaly detection |

quizData.question: What is the fundamental mathematical difference between a discriminative model and a generative model?

options.text: Discriminative models compute P(Y|X); generative models model the data distribution P(X) or joint P(X, Y)
Discriminative models can only run on CPU hardware
Generative models do not use neural networks
Discriminative models always require text tokens as input

quizData.explanation: Discriminative models learn boundary probabilities P(Y|X) to classify existing inputs, whereas generative models learn data distributions P(X) allowing synthesis of new data.

slides.title: The Nature of Hallucinations ⚠️
slides.content:
## Probability, Not Factuality
Autoregressive LLMs are trained to maximize the *likelihood of next tokens*, not truth. If an incorrect statement sounds statistically plausible in the training distribution, the model will output it with complete confidence. Always ground generation in verified sources!
